chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Dharih ibn Muhammad al-Muharibi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a man who forgets to say the Takbir (Allahu Akbar) until he has already recited (the Quran). He said, 'He should say the Takbir.'
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they forget to say the opening Takbir before reciting Quran in prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that forgetting the opening Takbir is a minor oversight that does not nullify the prayer, requiring only its subsequent recitation. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle of leniency in cases of unintentional error during worship, distinguishing between essential pillars and recommended acts. It reflects the broader legal methodology of prioritizing the continuity of prayer over strict procedural perfection when the omission is due to forgetfulness.
